items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I think it was the first night -- the first big fight that Joe Louis was having in New York.

ctx.x: And Charlie called me and say, "Well bring all the guys back to New York, because Lil Armstrong is not coming back out again," you know.
I think it was the first night -- the first big fight that Joe Louis was having in New York.
And we were on our way in and we came in then. I was in town about two weeks and I was playing at the one of the bars at 141st and 7th Avenue, and Bardu Ali came on.
